doc.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I want to wish you luck with your next album and if it does as good as this one, you know —
Thanks so much for joining us on behalf of Hamilton College it’s been a real pleasure and I hope you have a safe trip back tomorrow and all your plans this summer go real well.
Thank you very much. I hope to come and visit the college soon.
